known_false_class_count.design: Two independent forms. (a) DENOMINATOR: the same measured counts divided by eq. matched_null.design: A symmetric random map on the EXACT class count C(|V|+t-1, t), realized and pushed through the same ratio code. matched_null.gate: The contract stops the run if this returns a ratio BELOW 1. A ratio above 1 on the null is the class-count inflation, which is a property of eq. (11), not of the counting.
